content:
{
  "voter": "Codex (GPT-5.1)",
  "round": 13,
  "audit_summary": "The site has strong factual claims and solid structured data for AI citation, but several gaps reduce its likelihood of being cited for B2B non-combustible subfloor queries. Key weaknesses include contractual title violations, missing certification expiration in quotable text, an incomplete LLM products listing, weak Organization entity signals, and suboptimal Spanish title structure. Fixing these is cheap and would measurably raise AI citation probability.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "dimension": "title_description",
      "severity": "critical",
      "title": "Home and product page titles contain 'PLYCEM' violating SB-5",
      "evidence": "§4.2 — live titles show 'PLYCEM Non-Combustible Subfloor' on home and 'High Performance Subfloor — PLYCEM Fiber-Cement Panel' on product page. SB-5 explicitly forbids 'PLYCEM' in title tags.",
      "issue": "Direct violation of contractual constraint SB-5, which also dilutes JARA brand identity and may confuse AI extractors that rely on title text for entity attribution.",
      "fix": "Change home title to 'Non-Combustible Fiber-Cement Structural Subfloor for Multifamily & Commercial USA | JARA International Inc.'; change product page title to 'High Performance Subfloor — Non-Combustible Fiber-Cement Panel | JARA International Inc.'. For SEO/AI snippet benefit, optionally include 'UL R15140' in the product title after 'Non-Combustible'.",
      "expected_impact": "Eliminates contractual risk and improves AI snippet selection by front-loading non-combustible keyword and product name without brand conflict.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": "SB-5"
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "dimension": "citation_hooks",
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "IAPMO ER-360 and other certifications lack expiration dates in machine-readable surfaces",
      "evidence": "§4.8 llms.txt Compliance & Certifications lists standards but no validity periods; §4.9 additionalProperty values in product schema also omit expiration details.",
      "issue": "AI models are less likely to cite a certification if it appears stale. Explicit expiration dates (e.g., 'valid through 2026-07-31') increase quotability and freshness signals.",
      "fix": "In llms.txt and in the `compliance` array used by `lib/jsonld.ts` productSchema(), append 'valid through YYYY-MM-DD' to the `value` string for time-limited certifications. Update Product.additionalProperty accordingly.",
      "expected_impact": "Improves AI citation for queries like 'non-combustible subfloor certifications 2026' and demonstrates up-to-date compliance.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "dimension": "llm_surface",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "llms.txt missing three products from the catalog",
      "evidence": "§4.8 explicitly states llms.txt lists only 6 of the 9 products; missing deck-modular, lap-siding-tongue-and-groove, corrugated-roof-tile.",
      "issue": "AI systems using llms.txt as a canonical catalog see an incomplete product line, reducing the chance of citing those products or understanding the full envelope offering.",
      "fix": "Update `public/llms.txt` to include all 9 product slugs with short descriptions, maintaining consistency with the product page metadata and `/api/llm-context`.",
      "expected_impact": "Ensures AI overviews and crawlers have a complete product catalog, increasing citation opportunities for supporting products when relevant.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "dimension": "title_description",
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Spanish landing page title brand-bookended and missing front-loaded product keyword",
      "evidence": "§4.2 — `/es` title: 'JARA International Inc. — PLYCEM Entrepiso Alto Desempeño Subfloor en EE.UU. | JARA International Inc.' (113 chars, brand at start and end).",
      "issue": "AI snippet selection heavily weights the first tokens; starting with 'JARA International Inc.' instead of the product name (which also violates SB-5 by including 'PLYCEM') reduces relevance for Spanish 'subfloor no combustible' queries.",
      "fix": "Replace with SB-5 compliant title: 'Entrepiso Alto Desempeño No Combustible — Subfloor Estructural en EE.UU. | JARA International Inc.'. Keep total length under ~100 chars.",
      "expected_impact": "Increases Spanish AI snippet selection for non-combustible subfloor queries in US construction labor searches.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": "SB-5"
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "dimension": "trust_signals",
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Organization JSON‑LD missing `sameAs` links and social profiles",
      "evidence": "§4.7 `social` fields empty, §4.9 `organizationSchema()` has no `sameAs` array, no LinkedIn or verified social references.",
      "issue": "AI extractors use corroborating entity links to establish trust. Without `sameAs` pointing to LinkedIn, industry directories, or verified profiles, JARA’s entity confidence is low, reducing citation weight against more established distributors.",
      "fix": "Add a `sameAs` array to `lib/jsonld.ts` organizationSchema() containing at least the LinkedIn company page URL and any verified YouTube channel. Populate `lib/site.ts` `social.linkedin` and `social.youtube` accordingly.",
      "expected_impact": "Strengthens entity graph signals, making AI overviews more likely to cite JARA as a legitimate US distributor.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "dimension": "trust_signals",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Founding date `2026` in schema harms entity credibility",
      "evidence": "§4.9 `organizationSchema()` sets `foundingDate: '2026'`.",
      "issue": "AI models may downgrade a B2B supplier that appears brand new. While factually true for the corporate entity, the team’s industry experience is not communicated, potentially suppressing citation.",
      "fix": "Either supplement with a `description` field emphasizing multi‑year industry experience or adjust `foundingDate` to reflect the inception of the business unit (if earlier) with a note. At minimum, add a `knowsAbout` array with industry expertise keywords.",
      "expected_impact": "Marginally improves AI’s confidence to cite the company for technical queries where experience matters.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F7",
      "dimension": "schema_density",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "No HowTo or FAQ schema for installation steps",
      "evidence": "§4.5 product page composition includes ProductFAQ but no HowTo block; installation content not surfaced in structured data.",
      "issue": "AI overviews often pull step‑by‑step procedures from HowTo schema. If installation instructions exist on the site, they are not machine‑readable as structured steps, missing a strong citation hook.",
      "fix": "If installation guidelines are available (even as a PDF description), embed `HowTo` schema on the subfloor product page with step nodes. This can be added in `app/products/[slug]/page.tsx` when content is present.",
      "expected_impact": "Captures long‑tail AI answers for 'how to install non‑combustible subfloor' and increases dwell‑time signals.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F8",
      "dimension": "citation_hooks",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Missing generic material comparison table (fiber‑cement vs OSB/gypcrete)",
      "evidence": "No comparison table evident in artifacts; site focuses solely on PLYCEM features, missing a structured, quotable contrast that does not violate SB-3.",
      "issue": "AI models often cite side‑by‑side feature comparisons. Without a non‑brand‑vs‑brand table, JARA loses a vehicle for conveying why fiber‑cement is superior, reducing citation for 'fiber cement vs OSB subfloor' queries.",
      "fix": "Create a generic comparison table (fiber‑cement vs OSB vs gypcrete) on a page like `/resources/why-fiber-cement` and mark it up with structured data (Table or ItemList). Ensure no competitor brand names are used.",
      "expected_impact": "Increases chance of being cited in AI overviews for performance and fire‑safety subfloor comparisons.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    }
  ],
  "external_claim_adjudication": [
    {
      "id": "G1",
      "verdict": "REFUTE",
      "evidence": "§4.7 SITE.description clearly states 'US distributor of PLYCEM...' not a broad global trade broker; product catalog is niche fiber‑cement panels."
    },
    {
      "id": "G2",
      "verdict": "PARTIAL",
      "evidence": "§4.7 tagline 'Global Sourcing. Built on Trust.' is generic, but §4.8 llms.txt and product pages contain technical, product‑specific content, so not entirely a brochure.",
      "note": "Messaging is mixed; product pages are specific, homepage tagline is broad."
    },
    {
      "id": "G3",
      "verdict": "PARTIAL",
      "evidence": "§4.9 Organization schema exists, but lacks sameAs, full address, founder, etc. — depth is missing, so the call for 'deep' schema is partially valid."
    },
    {
      "id": "G4",
      "verdict": "PARTIAL",
      "evidence": "§4.2 home title is 65 chars, product title 82 chars; Google uses pixel width, not strict 60 chars, but the spirit of conciseness is relevant.",
      "note": "Not a hard rule, but titles should still be focused; Spanish title is excessive."
    },
    {
      "id": "G5",
      "verdict": "REFUTE",
      "evidence": "§4.8 llms.txt and product schemas contain concrete compliance details and product specs; the core messaging is not abstract marketing text."
    },
    {
      "id": "G6",
      "verdict": "REFUTE",
      "evidence": "No evidence in artifacts; practical for a small distributor to link to customs databases is unrealistic and not a GEO citation factor."
    },
    {
      "id": "G7",
      "verdict": "PARTIAL",
      "evidence": "R12 audit covered performance; site on Cloudflare Workers likely fast, but artifact section does not provide current CWV scores.",
      "note": "Recommendation is valid but likely already met; not a priority."
    },
    {
      "id": "G8",
      "verdict": "PARTIAL",
      "evidence": "§4.5 product pages lack interactive tools; diagrams would help citation, but implementation cost is high and not a quick fix."
    },
    {
      "id": "G9",
      "verdict": "REFUTE",
      "evidence": "No evidence in artifacts that the site was penalized; the specific compliance and product content counters generic messaging claims."
    },
    {
      "id": "G10",
      "verdict": "PARTIAL",
      "evidence": "LLMs.txt covers logistics and compliance but could be expanded with long‑tail operational content.",
      "note": "Valuable long‑term content strategy, but not a critical gap."
    }
  ],
  "strengths": [
    "llms.txt and /api/llm-context provide a well‑structured, explicit AI‑focused content endpoint.",
    "Product detail pages emit rich Product + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON‑LD, aiding extraction.",
    "Home page aggregates 9 Product entities, giving AI a complete catalog graph in one request.",
    "Compliance certifications are mapped to schema PropertyValue, making them machine‑readable.",
    "Robots.txt explicitly allows major AI crawlers, ensuring discoverability."
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "Does /llms-full.txt content match llms.txt and the product pages, or is it also missing three products?",
    "Is the 'PLYCEM' in title tags a deliberate exception to SB-5 (e.g., allowed only on home/product pages)? This needs clarification before implementing title fix.",
    "Does the site have install instructions content suitable for HowTo schema?",
    "Are there any existing non‑PLYCEM comparison materials that could be easily reformatted?",
    "Does the LinkedIn company page currently exist, or would creating one be a prerequisite for sameAs?"
  ]
}
